tips.text: Run Ascension on Steel Path if you have it; it takes the same time but pays about 45% more motes.
Throw each Boosted Ionic Charge the moment you find it; the larger, double-outlined ones give 3x elevator speed for 10 seconds.
Throw Ionic Charges during the ride instead of fighting; the capsule can't be damaged, so killing enemies does not move it.
Bring a mobile frame such as Zephyr, Titania, Wukong or Voruna to sweep the platforms for boosted charges and beacons.
Run it solo or with a premade; organized squads clear in under 6 minutes while public squads often take 8 or more.
Keep a few ordinary charges in reserve; burning them all early leaves the lift stalled when drops run dry.
Decide your Jade purchase order before you spend motes; every Jade part and weapon uses the same pool.
Players call Ascension a slow but fair grind, and the 300-mote buy caps how bad the luck can get.
